data: Apple reported diluted earnings per share of $6.13 in fiscal 2023 (year ended September 30, 2023), compared with $6.11 in fiscal 2022 (year ended September 24, 2022). That is an increase of $0.02, or roughly 0.3%. Net income for fiscal 2023 was $96,995 million (about $97.0 billion), down about 2.8% from $99,803 million in fiscal 2022. Diluted EPS still edged up because the diluted share count fell from about 16.33 billion to 15.81 billion shares, reflecting the company's buybacks of $77.6 billion in fiscal 2023.
